notes: How this part was researched: the session's web-search allowance ran out partway (about two dozen searches were answered, then "200 of 200 used"), so the legislative, statewide, county and court candidates were searched and most of the city and school board candidates were not. Pages were opened directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py), robots.txt first and obeyed, one request at a time. The campaign websites the candidates filed were learned by running the kit's own step (python -m ballot.local_sites files) on a scratch copy of the database; the real database was only read.

Ten of the thirty filed a website. Six are recorded, each opened and read (Seifert, Trautmann Cordova, Nelson, Filipovich, Choi, Wale). Houdek's was removed by the verifier: the site returned an empty page on every try. Not recorded: hudsonformn.com (Walter Hudson; its robots.txt asks scripts to stay out, so it was not opened); rolbiecki4sheriff.com (Charles Rolbiecki; it answered with an empty 168-byte page); lincolnfor281.my.canva.site (Anthony Lincoln; a Canva page whose only readable text is "Home"). A second reader with a browser could confirm those three.

Republican endorsements: only Jeff Houdek's is on a party's own page. The Marshall Independent (March 24, 2026, "Seifert receives Republican endorsement in SD15", https://www.marshallindependent.com/news/local-news/2026/03/seifert-receives-republican-endorsement-in-sd15/) reports that Braxton Seifert was endorsed at the Senate District 15 Republican convention; that is a newspaper, not the party's page, so no endorsed_by is recorded for him. No party page was found for Nathan Nelson or Walter Hudson (both sitting members).

Simon Trautmann Cordova's site says "Simon is proud to be the Labor endorsed candidate for Senate District 51"; that is not a party, so no own_words is recorded. The City of Richfield's pages opened here did not give the years of his council service.
John Choi and Zack Filipovich: no birth year found.

Judges: mncourts.gov asks scripts to stay out (robots.txt), so there is no official page for Kelly Olmstead or Patricia A. Aanes; their appointments come from Minnesota Lawyer and the archived Governor's release.
Ages printed in news stories were not turned into birth years: an age fits two birth years.

Nothing was found beyond what they filed for Joel A. Novak (the Douglas County board page lists Tim Kalina for District 2), Aaron Young (KAXE's Cass County guide: "KAXE did not receive a response from this candidate"), Justin Redalen, Charles Rolbiecki, David Pritzlaff, Mike Schmitz, Lexi Temple, Gusta G. Carr, Kris Johnson, Al Kremeier, Dijon Ledin, Anthony Lincoln, Joe "Joe(Y)" Christenson or Ashley Cegielski. The council or board pages of Farmington, Andover, South St. Paul, Northfield and Fergus Falls and of the Robbinsdale, Rochester and Stillwater schools were read and do not show them in office today; the Pequot Lakes schools' board page and the City of Faribault's site could not be reached. Walter Hudson and Nathan Nelson are sitting legislators with record pages already.

Verifier, 2026-10-02: every url in the file was re-opened with the kit's honest User-Agent (robots.txt read first). 32 findings checked; 31 kept, 4 of them with corrected wording or years (Filipovich's council source, Schmidt's start year, Wale's two city boards); 1 removed (Houdek's website). Notes that touched on a person's origin, job or age were cut, since those are never collected.
